description: Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing: GSM7471948: Ctrl RNA-seq rep2 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: RNA was extracted from cells using RNeasy Plus Mini Kit (Qiagen, cat. no. 74134) and Quick-RNA MiniPrep Kit (Zymo Research, cat. no. R1054) the Illumina TruSeq RNA Library preparation protocol: PolyA RNA is captured by oligodT beads and fragmented when eluted from the beads. The first-strand cDNA was synthesized by reverse transcriptase using dNTP, whereas the second-strand cDNA was generated using a dUTP mix . After end-repair, dA-tailing and adapter ligation, the dUTP-containing second strand is digested by uracil DNA glycosylase, rendering it unamplifiable in the subsequent PCR step. Hence the resulting library contains only PCR product of the first-strand cDNA. And then, the barcoded DNA was amplified by 15-cycle PCR. Libraries were sequenced on Illumina Genome Analyzer II, HiSeq 2000, or HiSeq 2500.
